args.title: Redwood Ridge Team Offsite — Venue-Screening Checklist
args.body:
# Redwood Ridge Team Offsite — Venue-Screening Checklist

Use this checklist to screen venues before selecting one. Record the source or contact for each confirmation.

## 1. Non-negotiable requirements

- [ ] Date and time window are available for the full offsite.
- [ ] Capacity supports the expected attendee count with a comfortable layout.
- [ ] Business-grade internet is confirmed directly with the property operations contact; do not rely on the venue website or marketing PDF.
- [ ] Reliable power and sufficient outlets are available for all participants.
- [ ] The space supports the planned work format, including presentations, discussion, and breakout work.
- [ ] Total cost is within the approved budget, including taxes, service fees, room fees, AV, internet, food, and cancellation-related charges.

## 2. Space and working setup

- [ ] Room dimensions and floor plan are suitable for the group.
- [ ] Seating can be arranged for the intended format.
- [ ] There is adequate privacy and low enough ambient noise for focused work.
- [ ] Natural light, temperature control, and comfortable seating are acceptable.
- [ ] A separate area is available for breaks, informal conversations, or phone calls.
- [ ] Setup and teardown time are included in the booking window.
- [ ] The venue can accommodate whiteboards, flip charts, signage, and other collaboration materials.

## 3. Technology and AV

- [ ] Wi-Fi performance, network access method, and support contact are documented.
- [ ] Video-conferencing capability is available if needed, with a suitable camera, microphone, speakers, and display.
- [ ] Display/projector, HDMI/USB-C connections, adapters, and presentation support are confirmed.
- [ ] On-site technical support and response times are understood.
- [ ] Backup options exist for connectivity or presentation equipment failures.

## 4. Food and hospitality

- [ ] Breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages are available for the planned schedule.
- [ ] Default the offsite team meal to Tava Kitchen unless there is a dietary reason not to.
- [ ] Dietary restrictions, allergies, and labeling requirements can be accommodated.
- [ ] Meal timing will not disrupt the agenda.
- [ ] Outside catering or restaurant delivery policies are confirmed.
- [ ] Water, coffee, tea, and other agreed refreshments are included or priced clearly.

## 5. Access and logistics

- [ ] Location and travel time are reasonable for attendees.
- [ ] Public transit, rideshare, parking, and arrival instructions are documented.
- [ ] Building access, check-in, security, and after-hours procedures are clear.
- [ ] The venue is accessible, including entrances, restrooms, elevators, and room layout.
- [ ] Restrooms are conveniently located and sufficient for the group.
- [ ] Nearby lodging is available if overnight travel is expected.
- [ ] Emergency procedures and a venue contact are provided.

## 6. Commercial and contractual review

- [ ] Itemized quote is received and all mandatory charges are identified.
- [ ] Deposit, payment schedule, taxes, and gratuity/service charges are understood.
- [ ] Cancellation, rescheduling, attrition, and force-majeure terms are acceptable.
- [ ] Insurance, liability, damage, and security-deposit requirements are reviewed.
- [ ] The booking contact and escalation path are documented.
- [ ] Any restrictions on signage, photography, recording, food, or outside vendors are acceptable.

## 7. Final screening record

- Venue: ______________________________
- Primary contact: ______________________
- Date screened: ________________________
- Proposed date and time: _______________
- Expected attendees: ___________________
- Estimated all-in cost: ________________
- Internet confirmed directly by property operations: Yes / No
- Overall status: Shortlist / Hold / Reject
- Open questions or risks: ______________

### Decision

- [ ] All non-negotiable requirements are confirmed.
- [ ] Outstanding risks have an owner and deadline.
- [ ] At least one comparable venue has been screened.
- [ ] Final recommendation approved by: ____________________
- [ ] Approval date: ____________________
